facts.function: cover/housing for an electric motor controller
facts.end_use: part of motor controller (switchgear/control apparatus of heading 8537, assumed)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8538 covers parts suitable for use solely or principally with apparatus of headings 8535, 8536 or 8537; Section XVI note 2(b) places parts suitable solely or principally for such machines in the heading of the machine or in 8538

rejected_alternatives.reason: general plastic articles; dedicated parts of electrical apparatus go to 8538 per Section XVI note 2
other non-molded parts; assumed molded plastic
other parts line used for parts not molded; not selected given molded plastic cover

missing_facts: Whether the cover is molded plastic and whether the controller is switchgear of heading 8537 (vs. another device)
classification.rationale: Plastic covers dedicated to a motor controller are parts of heading 8537 apparatus, which go to 8538.90. Ruling J81221 classified molded plastic housings under 8538.90.6000. Assumed molded and heading 8537 controller.
